paragraphs: I have spent the last several years building products that people rely on every day, and the chance to bring that experience to this role is exactly the kind of work I want to be doing next.

In my most recent position I took over a release process that regularly slipped by weeks. I sat with each team to find where the delays really came from, rewrote the checklist around those findings, and within two quarters we were shipping on the planned date. That project taught me that most hard problems are a mix of people and systems, and that listening comes first.
Colleagues tend to come to me when something is unclear, because I write things down and follow them through. I enjoy turning a messy situation into a plan that everyone can see and trust.

What draws me to your team is the focus the job description puts on careful, steady improvement and on working closely with the people who use the product. I would be glad to bring that same care to your work from the first week.
